name: You're my Angel
source:
It's a boring day until a demon lands in your room?!
And he claims you're his... Angel?!

[From [url=https://writer31.itch.io/youre-my-angel]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
本來只是無聊的一天，直到一個惡魔掉進了你的房間？！
而且他竟然說你是他的……天使？！
